articles.title: Steuerskandal: Cum-Ex-Drahtzieher Hanno Berger muss zehn Jahre in Haft
articles.teaser: Wegen Steuerhinterziehung muss Hanno Berger zehn Jahre ins Gefängnis. Der frühere Steueranwalt gilt als Schlüsselfigur der Cum-Ex-Geschäfte.
articles.image_title: Steuerskandal: WIESBADEN, GERMANY - MAY 30: Defendant Hanno Berger arrives at a courtroom at the District Court for the announcement of the verdict in the trial over the 'Cum-Ex' scandal, a massive tax fraud scam that cost the government billions of euros, on May 30, 2023 in Wiesbaden, Germany. The court sentenced tax attorney Hanno Berger to a long prison term for his involvement and found the 72-year-old guilty of three counts of serious tax evasion and ordered eight years and three months in prison and the confiscation of one million euros. The Bonn Regional Court had already sentenced Berger to eight years in prison in December 2022. (Photo by Helmut Fricke - Pool/Getty Images)

articles.title: Lieferstopp für Öl aus Kasachstan: Beschäftigungsgarantie für Raffinerie in Schwedt wird verlängert
articles.teaser: Die Bundesregierung hilft der wichtigen Ölraffinerie in Schwedt. Die Beschäftigungsgarantie wird inmitten eines von Russland ausgelösten Lieferstopps verlängert.
articles.image_title: Lieferstopp für Öl aus Kasachstan: A general overview taken on April 30, 2026 shows an entry gate to the PCK refinery, which supplies oil to Berlin and the surrounding region, in Schwedt, northeastern Germany. Germany has learned that Russia plans to halt the flow of Kazakh oil through the Druzhba pipeline to the PCK refinery in eastern Germany starting May 1, 2026 the energy ministry in Berlin told AFP on April 22, 2026. The move comes amid Russia's war against Ukraine and a global energy crisis linked to the US-Israeli war against Iran, which has caused major disruptions to global oil and gas markets. The PCK refinery near the Polish border supplies much of the Berlin region with fuel, but the German energy ministry voiced confidence the impact would be limited. (Photo by Tobias SCHWARZ / AFP via Getty Images)
